purpose: Route for rerunning the independent reviewer's retained program. RERUN.json (the producer's) is unchanged and covers only the two producer programs.
commands: create the output directory named on line 191 of the program (mkdir -p on that directory)
path_note: The program writes its output file to a fixed path in the reviewer's scratch area, given literally on line 191 of the program; that directory must exist. The source was not altered.
expected_output: review/reviewer-1/rev-a-rq9-a_check_output.txt (reviewer) and review/publisher_rerun/rev-a-rq9-a_check_rerun_output.txt (publisher); identical except the two elapsed-time lines
covers: checks C1 to C7 and the sanity line only; it does not read the producer's binary files
not_retained: the post-exposure comparison helper named in the verdict
